feed.title: UK News - The latest headlines from the UK | Sky News

articles.title: Meghan's brother a 'person of interest' in child abuse image claims
articles.summary: Meghan Markle's half brother has been named as a "person of interest" in an investigation into child sexual abuse image allegations against the Duchess of Sussex's father.

articles.title: Henry Nowak's family react as his killer has jail sentence increased
articles.summary: Henry Nowak's family say they face a "life sentence of grief" and their "fight for justice is far from over" after his killer's jail term was increased.

articles.title: British doctor with Ebola returns to UK for treatment
articles.summary: A British doctor who tested positive for Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo has returned to the UK for treatment.

articles.title: PM reviewing decision to give UK military satellite system contract to US firm
articles.summary: Andy Burnham must settle a bitter battle on Earth between rival American and European companies over the future in space of a critical UK military satellite system.

articles.title: Police and paramedics attacked with fireworks while responding to injured person
articles.summary: Police and paramedics were attacked with fireworks as they tried to reach an injured man, with a police vehicle also set alight.
